notes:
# Fold the meeting list away {chevron}
The handle on the edge of the list slides it out of the way when you want the
whole window for the meeting you are editing, and back when you don't.

# Opens in about a second {clock}
Starting RecordLah took six seconds and now takes one: the settings pages are
built the first time you open them, and the meeting list fills in as it
appears rather than all at once.

# Forms that say what is wrong {notes}
A missing Zoom link is marked on the field itself, with the reason under it,
instead of a box in the middle of the screen — and the page scrolls to it.

---

Everything else in this release:

- Every input has the same rounded shape as the pickers beside it, in the
  meeting form, in Settings, and in the time and time-zone panels.
- What you want Gemini to look for is now a proper text box rather than a
  single line, and it is shown as the first question when you open the notes.
- A new meeting is scrolled into view instead of being selected off-screen.
- Alerts appear in the middle of the window, in the app's own style, rather
  than wherever macOS decided to put them.
- Update checks wait while a recording is running, and stand aside when a
  scheduled recording is due within ten minutes.
- The refresh and ? marks in the toolbar are legible.
